stories.headline: Jensen Huang affair puts Nvidia's future at risk, with no clear successor to the renowned CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, leading the company's board to open an investigation into whether he was targeted by a foreign intelligence agency. Shares of Nvidia dropped over 4% following the news amid concerns about leadership stability and succession planning at the chipmaker. The board expressed confidence in Huang and stated there is currently no indication that national security or trade secrets were compromised.

stories.headline: Ecosystem Roundup: Nvidia board probes Jensen Huang over affair with Megaspeed exec
stories.summary: Nvidia's board of directors has launched an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after he admitted to an affair with an executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed. The probe comes after a memo circulated among US policymakers earlier this year alleging potential espionage connections involving China's Ministry of State Security.

stories.headline: 👨🏿‍🚀TechCabal Daily – ‘Too much Access’
stories.summary: NVIDIA's board of directors has opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following reports linking him to a former chip distributor executive suspected by US officials of ties to Chinese intelligence. Although NVIDIA stated it has no reason to believe any trade secrets or proprietary technology were compromised, authorities are investigating whether Huang was targeted in a foreign espionage effort.

stories.headline: OpenAI Deploys Control Room With 35-Second Kill Switch Amid Security Concerns
stories.summary: OpenAI has deployed Control Room, a centralized monitoring system designed to address security concerns around autonomous AI agents. The system includes a 35-second kill switch to quickly shut down operations if rogue or unsafe behavior is detected.

stories.headline: Faisal Islam: What Jensen Huang told me about China, national security and persuading Trump
stories.summary: BBC reporter Faisal Islam details insights from an interview with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang regarding artificial intelligence, global microchip supply chains, and national security policy. The discussion underscores Nvidia's critical position in supplying the hardware required for frontier AI models amid heightened US-China geopolitical tensions.

stories.headline: Sarvam Ropes In Google Cloud India MD Sashikumar Sreedharan As President & CBO
stories.summary: Indian AI startup Sarvam has appointed former Google Cloud India Managing Director Sashikumar Sreedharan as its President and Chief Business Officer. In his new role, Sreedharan will lead the company's commercial operations, enterprise partnerships, and business expansion strategies as Sarvam scales its sovereign AI platform.

stories.headline: SEBI Clears MakeMyTrip’s India IPO
stories.summary: India's market regulator SEBI has approved Nasdaq-listed online travel aggregator MakeMyTrip to launch an initial public offering in India. The approval allows the traveltech giant to establish a domestic listing alongside its US trading presence.

stories.headline: SoftBank swings to $7 billion loss after U.S. data center hit and Intel share decline
stories.summary: SoftBank Group reported a fiscal second-quarter net loss of 1.12 trillion yen ($7 billion), driven by written-down investments in U.S. AI data center power generation equipment and declines in Intel share value. The Japanese investment firm made advance investments totaling $9.48 billion as of late September to secure power equipment amid global grid bottlenecks and long lead times affecting AI infrastructure buildouts. The heavy losses highlight how energy supply constraints are increasingly impacting major technology infrastructure projects.

stories.headline: Nigeria turns to hybrid cloud infrastructure for its postcode database
stories.summary: Technical checks of Nigeria's public postcode database domain show that it is currently hosted on Amazon Web Services infrastructure in the United States. The discovery has raised concerns regarding data sovereignty as the country pushes to keep critical public digital assets hosted locally.

stories.headline: Security Flaws Across UK Government Sites Exposed ‘God-Tier’ Information
stories.summary: A security researcher discovered over 100 serious vulnerabilities within publicly accessible UK government code repositories, exposing sensitive data across multiple departments. The flaws, identified using off-the-shelf AI models, resulted from poor cyber hygiene and neglected IT maintenance rather than sophisticated cyberattacks.
